author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Seventy-Three! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Do you own a tricorn-hat? Are you worried about the living dead overthrowing your village and possibly getting your collection of corn-husk apple dolls? Band together with your friends and hunt the eldritch in Black Site Studios new HALLOWTIDE. Let's check it out!

Check out the rules HERE : https://blacksitestudio.com/en-ca/products/hallowtide-quickstart-preview
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 073 - Hallowtide by Black Site Studio
